scope: Relevant installed physical-item packs; not a claim that every installed pack or world compendium was searched.

entries.name: Pouch, Waist
entries.reason: Correct leather waist-pouch description, 0.5 gp and 0.5 lb; imported record is loot and has a placeholder image. Use the existing kit illustration and native container type.

entries.name: Wolfsbane
entries.reason: Rules text, source-book ID and image are present; keep five doses.

entries.name: Weapon Blanch (Silver)
entries.reason: Correct silver variant, consumable type, full description, non-placeholder core icon and source/page.

entries.name: Deodorizing Agent (Vial)
entries.reason: Better than the system generic loot entry: consumable type, complete description, source/page and a vial icon.

entries.name: Dagger
entries.reason: Base dagger has appropriate weapon data, two native attacks, image and descriptive superficial text. Create a silver variant with a 20 gp light-weapon surcharge; material effects need review.

assembly.pouchInterpretation: Map unspecified leather pouch to the waist-pouch entry; this interpretation reconciles the listed kit price and weight exactly. Do not add a second pouch inside the outer container.

constraints: Normalize and review any reused document before making it canonical.
Do not copy upstream artwork into distributable assets without rights review.
Do not double-count total kit price or weight on the empty container.
Do not require optional source modules without resolving the requested reuse delivery policy.
Preserve the existing kit ID and source key.
delivery: Package normalized reviewed copies; preserve attribution and reference installed core/PF1 artwork. No pf-content dependency.
